title: Isagi's 3 most EGOIST moments in Blue Lock #shorts
description:
Ranking Yoichi Isagi's biggest ego awakenings. Which one is your number 1?
Read Blue Lock officially on K MANGA.

scenes.question: What's Isagi's most egoist moment ever?
scenes.answer: Easy. But number one will surprise you.
scenes.voice: What is Isagi's most egoist moment ever? Easy. But number one will surprise you.

scenes.on_screen: #3 The first goal that was truly HIS

scenes.voice: Number two. He sees the whole field like a puzzle, and puts himself in the last piece.

scenes.on_screen: #1 Turning a rival's play into his own goal
scenes.voice: Number one. He takes a rival's best play, and turns it into his own goal. Pure ego.
